concerns.text: Task T015 bundles three distinct deliverables (final report generation, README update, CI workflow creation) and verifies them with a single high‑level CI pass check. This makes the task too coarse for deterministic execution; it should be split into separate tasks (e.g., T015a — Generate `final_report.md`; T015b — Update `README.md`; T015c — Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and verify CI passes).
